task.title: Associate a behavior group with events
task.shortdesc: Use the following procedure to associate a notifications service behavior group with triggering events.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console.
You have Notifications administrator privileges configured in User Access.
A Notifications administrator has already created the behavior group.

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud Console, select the gear icon and then select SettingsSettings.
Under Settings, expand Notifications and select an application bundle where the behavior group was created, such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux or OpenShift.
Select a behavior group with which to associate events. You can enter the name of the group in the search box, or scroll through the behavior group cards.
In the list of events for the application bundle, click the pencil icon on the far right of the event name row. This will enable a drop-down list in the behavior column for the event.
Click the behavior drop-down list and select the behavior group(s) you want to associate with the event.
Click the checkmark in the event row to accept your selection for that event.
Repeat the previous step for each event.

info.note: Events can have multiple behavior groups associated with them. It is also possible that a behavior group is not associated with any event. In that case, when an event occurs, no action is taken.
